verdict.rationale: Ollama is a local model runtime that stores downloaded quantized models, so documenting upgrade compatibility for those files is a fair axis. The evidence pack has nothing on version compatibility, upgrade notes, or the stability of model file formats across runtime versions. The community note about a proprietary registry format concerns interoperability with other tools, not upgrade breakage, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether upgrading the runtime can break compatibility with previously downloaded quantized model files
